method: Read Google Trends Explore in the in-app browser; saved accessibility chart tables and screenshots. CSV files were transcribed programmatically from exposed chart tables, not downloaded native exports. The CSV button was attempted but no export file was located.

filters.language_note: English or Japanese query wording; not a language filter

interpretation: Google Trends indices are sampled normalized relative interest (0-100), not absolute search counts, monthly volume, market share, ranking difficulty or sales demand.
Compare numbers only within the same chart: e.g. governance 38 in global-core cannot be compared directly to governance 14 in global-agent or Japan 5.
A zero may indicate low volume, rounding or sampling/normalization limitations; it does not establish no searches or no commercial opportunity.
Current-week data may be incomplete. Do not report latest weekly change as growth. No growth claim has been made here.
Search terms are not Google topic entities and do not aggregate all synonyms or all languages. AI audit may mean auditing with AI or auditing AI; search-intent inspection is required.

The global related-query list contained unrelated consumer terms (e.g. food/travel queries). These were excluded rather than turned into SEO targets; no causal explanation for this anomaly is established.
Japan AI governance related queries included AI エージェント and AI 事業 者 ガイドライン. These are useful topic cues, not proof of commercial intent. Other unrelated rising terms were excluded.
No Search Console or analytics account was used in this research; site traffic, index coverage and conversions remain unverified.

priority_recommendations.action: Explain how verifiable audit trails support AI governance evidence; connect informational readers to VAP, VCP and verification materials. Retain accurate scope limitations: record integrity does not establish decision correctness or legal compliance.

priority_recommendations.action: Create or improve one substantial gateway explaining what agent actions/tool calls to record, tamper evidence, identity, verification and omissions. Link to published specs and reproducible examples; avoid generic agent-product listicles.

priority_recommendations.action: Keep commercially relevant narrow terms on dedicated existing product/specification pages, even though Trends relative indices are lower. Make scope and reader problem explicit.
Use in technical supporting content and explain relationship to content provenance; avoid making this narrow term the only homepage entrance.
Keep VeritasChain Standards Organization (VSO) and VeritasChain Protocol (VCP) paired with descriptive audit/provenance language; bare VSO/VCP are ambiguous.
